provenance.ballPolicy: Moxie-specific separate basketball approaches chest height; both empty hands meet it at frame2/tick4, then draw it in to her chest. No ball is baked into the poses.

review.reviewNotes: Four distinct complete right-facing Moxie receive poses with readable catch at frame2/tick4. Canon lavender eyes, long high ponytail/gold tie, purple/silver uniform, adult human anatomy and shoes are consistent. The separate ball is not drawn.

provenance.packaging: package-action4.py; 112x96 cells; baseline94; lossless WebP; 4 original receive poses

repack.fit: uniform scale, never upscale; max 86px high and cell width minus 10px; centered horizontally and baseline aligned with 5px bottom clearance

runtimeTrackCalibration.notes: Separate track checked at relevant contact, catch, gather or release frames in both facings at standard and120% native Canvas zoom; source atlas contains no ball.

reviewNotes: Full atlas reviewed on dark and light backgrounds after margin normalization: separated complete human poses, clean alpha, at least5px vertical and horizontal clearance, no crop bleed, Moxie canon and no baked ball.
